development_review: User-authorized forward (+X) loading then left (+Y) strike. Loading must first reach 0.25 m and 1 m/s within a 30-degree forward cone. User requested the cable as horizontal as possible. Soft whole-cable height RMS penalty, weight 2 and scale 0.25 m, with existing motion requirements retained. Higher 2.2 m starting hover permits controlled descent. Release must turn 70-110 degrees from the first loading velocity and sustain the speed/direction cone for 80 ms. Existing pullback and delayed cable velocity peak checks remain. Kinematic checks do not establish energy flux. Review full motion and recovery before export.
name: M5 forward-left whip with horizontal cable preference
